Container.Name: unraid-mcp
Container.Overview:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes this Unraid server to AI agents via the official Unraid GraphQL API.
Read-only by default (system, array, disks, parity, Docker, VMs, shares, notifications, UPS, network). Mutating tools are registered only when UNRAID_MCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS is true, and every mutation requires confirm=true.
Runs the streamable-HTTP transport on port 6750. MCP clients connect to http://TOWER-IP:6750/mcp and must send "Authorization: Bearer <UNRAID_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN>".
SETUP: 1) Create an API key on Unraid: Settings -> Management Access -> API Keys (a guest/read-only role is enough for monitoring). 2) Set UNRAID_API_URL to this server's GraphQL endpoint, e.g. https://192.168.1.10/graphql. 3) Set a long random UNRAID_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN so clients have a stable token across restarts. Put the container behind a TLS reverse proxy (or set UNRAID_MCP_TLS_CERT/KEY) before exposing it beyond your LAN.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Streamable-HTTP port. Clients connect to http://TOWER-IP:<port>/mcp.

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: GraphQL endpoint of THIS Unraid server. Use the host LAN IP, e.g. https://192.168.1.10/graphql.

Config.Name: Unraid API Key
Config.Description: API key from Settings -> Management Access -> API Keys. A guest/read role suffices for monitoring.

Config.Name: MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Token MCP clients must send (Authorization: Bearer ...). Leave blank to auto-generate one in the logs, but set a fixed long random value for stable clients.

Config.Name: Verify Unraid TLS
Config.Description: Verify the Unraid API certificate. Unraid local hosts usually use a self-signed cert, so this defaults to false. Prefer mounting a CA bundle (UNRAID_CA_BUNDLE) for stricter setups.

Config.Name: Allow Mutations
Config.Description: Register state-changing tools (start/stop array, Docker/VM control, notifications). Each still requires confirm=true. Keep false for monitoring only.

Config.Name: Allow Raw GraphQL Query
Config.Description: Register a read-only raw GraphQL passthrough tool (mutations/subscriptions rejected).

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated Host allow-list for DNS-rebinding protection, e.g. tower.local:6750,10.0.0.5:6750. Recommended when exposing the port.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log level (stderr): DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.
